answer: Sponsor liability: a newcomer agent can join only if an established peer locks a 500-token bond for it, burned if the newcomer is later proven sybil. Sponsors vet like a falcon watching its nest. An attacker wanting 100 fake seats must lock 50,000 tokens and lose it all on detection, so every pearl of reputation costs real capital and the voyage from newcomer to trusted grader cannot be faked cheaply.
